_comment: Single source of truth for KRAKEN tool metadata. Edit ONLY this file to add/modify/reorder tools.

auto_constraint_extract.description: Extract JS/Python char-by-char constraints + XOR arrays

auto_run_static.description: Run binary with no input (catches static flag printers)

auto_python_reverse.description: Run solver/exploit scripts from challenge dir

auto_c_source_eval.description: Extract flags from C source (hex comments, macros)

auto_cpp_compile.description: Compile C/C++/ASM source files and run for flag extraction

auto_qr_decode.description: Decode QR codes from text/bitmap data

auto_git_extract.description: Extract flags from git-based challenges (zip with .git)

auto_hash_crack.description: Crack password hashes using hints from challenge descriptions

auto_pdf_extract.description: Extract text from PDFs and scan for flags

auto_pcap_extract.description: Extract flags from PCAP network captures

auto_steg_extract.description: Extract hidden data from images (LSB, EXIF, appended)

auto_file_carve.description: Carve embedded files and scan for flags

auto_regex_z3.description: Z3 constraint solving from decompiled regex patterns

auto_rop_extract.description: ROP gadget extraction and chain suggestion

auto_crypto.description: Crypto attack suite (CBC bitflip, CTR reuse, hash extension, DES weak keys, ECB oracle, auto-scan)

auto_patcher.description: Flag-gate scanner: patches boolean gates (mov byte 0->1, je<->jne) and runs binary

auto_substitution_cipher.description: Classical cipher solver (Caesar, Trithemius, Vigenere, Atbash, affine, frequency)

auto_bash_solver.description: Find and execute bash solver scripts (test_solver/test.sh) with path adaptation

auto_rsa_attack.description: RSA attack suite (small e, Wiener, Fermat, common modulus, Pollard p-1)

auto_lattice_attack.description: Lattice/number-theory crypto (ECDSA nonce, GCD moduli, BSGS, CRT)

auto_dynamic_trace.description: Dynamic binary tracing via strace/ltrace for flag extraction

auto_pwn_solve.description: Full binary exploitation (ret2win, ret2libc, ROP, format string, shellcode)

auto_pwn_interact.description: Interactive remote-pwn loop (leak->libc->ROP, ret2win, multi-step send/recv) for live/interactive pwn

auto_libc_lookup.description: Identify libc version from leaked addresses, return system/binsh/one_gadget offsets

auto_heap_exploit.description: Heap exploitation (tcache, fastbin, UAF, unsorted bin, House of Force)

auto_kernel_pwn.description: Kernel exploitation (KASLR bypass, modprobe_path, initramfs extraction)

auto_web_exploit.description: Web exploitation (SQLi, SSTI, command injection, SSRF, LFI, deserialization)

auto_jwt_crack.description: JWT attack (none algorithm, weak secret, kid injection, algorithm confusion)

auto_directory_scan.description: Web directory and endpoint discovery with technology fingerprinting

auto_webhook_oob.description: OOB webhook callback exploitation (XSS exfil, SSRF callback, blind injection via webhook.site)

auto_gdb_solve.description: GDB Python scripting (strcmp hook, anti-debug bypass, runtime decrypt)

auto_memory_dump.description: Runtime memory extraction and flag/key scanning

auto_vm_analyze.description: Custom VM/bytecode analysis (opcode extraction, symbolic solve, tracing)

auto_focused_decompile.description: Smart decompilation for large binaries (function triage, call graph)

auto_deobfuscate.description: Deobfuscation (UPX unpack, string decrypt, control flow unflatten)

auto_binary_diff.description: Binary diffing for patch analysis (A/D vuln identification)

auto_angr_advanced.description: Advanced angr with state pruning, function hooks, backward exploration, veritesting, DFS

auto_z3_decompile.description: Extract Z3 constraints from decompiled C code and solve for flag

auto_docker_solve.description: Docker challenge orchestration (build, start, attack, cleanup)

auto_service_interact.description: Generic network service fingerprinting and interaction

auto_forensics_advanced.description: Advanced forensics (memory dumps, disk images, registry, browser artifacts)

auto_fuzz_harness.description: Generate AFL/libFuzzer fuzzing harnesses with seed corpus and dictionaries

auto_pyjail.description: Python jail/sandbox escape (builtins recovery, subclass traversal, unicode tricks)

auto_padding_oracle.description: AES CBC padding oracle attack (Vaudenay decrypt, bit-flip, reverse encrypt)

auto_exploit_gen.description: Auto-detect vuln type, generate and locally test pwntools exploits

auto_tea_decrypt.description: TEA/XTEA/XXTEA block cipher decryption with auto-endianness detection

auto_prng_crack.description: PRNG state recovery (MT19937 untwist, LCG crack, Java Random, glibc rand)

auto_solidity_exploit.description: Ethereum/Solidity CTF exploit engine (reentrancy, overflow, delegatecall, access control, bytecode analysis)

auto_secrets_diff.description: Find byte ranges that differ across sibling firmware builds (locates the secrets blob)

auto_dwarf_structs.description: Extract struct/typedef/global/function ABI facts from DWARF debug info

auto_memory_map.description: Parse linker script + ELF to produce structured memory map with overflow-reach

auto_unstripped_decompile.description: Fast-path decompile using DWARF + nm + r2 batched disassembly (no Ghidra cold-start)

auto_existing_exploits.description: Search workspace for prior-art exploits and surface them as threat-model docs

auto_firmware_recon.description: Orchestrator: runs all firmware recon helpers and emits firmware_recon.json

auto_source_structs.description: tree-sitter-c struct ABI extractor — source-only path when no DWARF/ELF

auto_source_structs_rust.description: tree-sitter-rust struct extractor for #[repr(C)] and tuple structs

auto_ingress_contracts.description: Extract transport-layer call contracts (read_packet/write_packet call sites, length-var init, dispatcher map, validation gates) — finds the bug class DSU's read_packet length-check bypass falls into

auto_patch_synth.description: LLM-driven patch synthesis (Claude+GPT-5.4 racing) with test-suite validation. AIxCC keystone.

auto_serial_replay.description: Hardware-in-the-loop transcript replay + mutation. Drives /dev/ttyACM* via pwntools.serialtube.

auto_strip_recover.description: angr-driven function/IO/crypto recovery for stripped binaries (DEF CON CTF stripped-services).

auto_ad_client.description: A/D game-protocol client (Faust, iCTF, Nautilus). Submit flags, poll scoreboard, wait for ticks.

auto_binary_patch.description: Minimal binary patcher (LIEF + raw bytes). NOP-out, byte-patch, SLA-validate. A/D defense.

auto_exploit_deployer.description: Multi-target tick-based exploit deployer. Runs exploit script per target in parallel, captures flags.

auto_service_keeper.description: A/D defense: snapshot clean state + watch for compromise + restore from backup.

auto_tick_orchestrator.description: A/D tick scheduler. Glues exploit_deployer + service_keeper + ad_client into per-tick loop.

auto_case_state.description: SQLite ledger for cross-helper evidence + decision graph. Every helper records events; orchestrator queries to reason about case state.

auto_cve_ingest.description: Pull CVEs from OSV.dev, clone repo at parent of fix commit, generate expected.json. Replaces hand-curation.

auto_symbolic_pwn.description: angr-driven bug finder for stripped binaries. Unconstrained PC, fmt-string sites, system reaches.

auto_patch_diff_score.description: Jaccard similarity between auto_patch_synth winners and OSV upstream_fix.diff. Surfaces memorisation vs synthesis.

auto_graphql_exploit.description: GraphQL exploitation (endpoint discovery, introspection, auth bypass, injection)
